source: VAT Decree-Law Article 48 · VAT Executive Regulation Article 48
headline: FOREIGN SOFTWARE
STILL CARRIES

blocks.text: Our overseas software supplier charges no VAT, so there is nothing to report.

items: A VAT-registered business **accounts for the VAT itself** under the reverse charge
Report it in the return covering the **date of supply**
Keep the **supplier's invoice**. Since **1 January 2026**, no self-invoice is needed
